name: rollcall_vhumancombatpatrol
about: Roll call: classname npc_VHumanCombatPatrol builds CNPC_VHumanCombatPatrol (factory 0x10387660, research/tooling/ghidra/driver/kernel_factories.tsv). One row taken verbatim from la_museum_1 (npc_guard_b1) stands in the arena; NPCThink 0x10292de0 -> RunAI 0x1026f110 -> MaintainSchedule: on its first thinks the class's SelectSchedule (its own override or the Troika arm it inherits) picks a program and SetSchedule 0x10280e50 installs it; the program then runs (StartTask/RunTask) for the rest of the ten seconds without a task failing every think. Corrected 2026-10-04 (V3b, a record error): the row is use_interesting 1 (la_museum_1 npc_guard_b1, use_interesting 1 / groups 5), so CAI_BaseNPCTroika::SelectSchedule case 1 step 4 (0x102af6eb) answers 0xff SCHED_TROIKA_WALK_TO_INTERESTING_PLACE_SETUP at once; the arena stands no place its groups admit (eligibility 0x102dad60: +0x574 & m_iInterestingPlaceGroups +0x62dc), so TASK_FIND_INTERESTING_PLACE fails at 0x102a1f34 with TaskFail(0x22) 'No interesting places were available to go to.' and the program's fail schedule runs (~5.1 s) before 0xff asks again. Retail fails that task at most twice in ten seconds, never every think.
